info.title: CSP2All API
info.description: Record-first API for CSP shops. Money is integer paise (fields end in `Paise`). Business dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` in the shop timezone; instants are ISO-8601 UTC. Errors use stable `error.code` values. Manual records are operator-reported and never trigger provider execution.
